description.en: Enables interaction with the CoinGecko Pro API to access cryptocurrency data including price history and market metrics through both MCP and OpenAI function calling.
description.zh-Hans: 启用与CoinGecko Pro API的交互，通过MCP和OpenAI功能调用访问加密货币数据，包括价格历史和市场指标。
